raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- Turn off Inductor pointwise autotuning (`triton.autotune_pointwise`) next to deterministic mode in `test_write_dummy_e2e_rocm.py`, and update the comment and docstring that explain why

Since the ROCm 10 image became the default (#58761), the attention-only cases fail with first-token log-prob distances of one or two bf16 steps (0.03-0.14), e.g. https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/95663. P/D is not involved: two plain direct serves of the same model on the same GPU disagree by the same amount, while each server is bitwise stable across repeats. Inductor's deterministic mode only pins reduction configs and still picks the XBLOCK of pointwise kernels by timing. On ROCm the XBLOCK changes which multiply-adds of the fused QK-norm + RoPE kernel get contracted into FMAs (e.g. 4 unfused packed adds at XBLOCK 1024, none at 4096), and the candidates are within timing noise of each other, so each server ends up with a random config. Pinning every pointwise kernel's config in two fresh processes makes them agree bitwise; flipping only the QK-norm + RoPE kernel's XBLOCK reproduces the CI distances.

With this change the CI-failing `qwen3_dense-TRITON_ATTN-P_FULL_AND_PIECEWISE-D_FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` case passes 10/10 on MI355 with ROCm 10 (distances exactly 0.0, full external prefix-cache hits).

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

detail.body:
- Turn off Inductor pointwise autotuning (`triton.autotune_pointwise`) next to deterministic mode in `test_write_dummy_e2e_rocm.py`, and update the comment and docstring that explain why

Inductor's deterministic mode only pins reduction configs and still picks the XBLOCK of pointwise kernels by timing. On ROCm the XBLOCK changes which multiply-adds of the fused QK-norm + RoPE kernel get contracted into FMAs (e.g. 4 unfused packed adds at XBLOCK 1024, none at 4096), and the candidates are within timing noise of each other, so each server ends up with a random config. Pinning every pointwise kernel's config in two fresh processes makes them agree bitwise; flipping only the QK-norm + RoPE kernel's XBLOCK reproduces the CI distances.

With this change the CI-failing `qwen3_dense-TRITON_ATTN-P_FULL_AND_PIECEWISE-D_FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` case passes 10/10 on MI355 with ROCm 10 (distances exactly 0.0, full external prefix-cache hits).

detail.title: [ROCm][CI] Pin Inductor pointwise configs in the MoRIIO dummy-weight P/D test

files.patch:
@@ -26,9 +26,9 @@
 a whole number of chunks plus one token. With the split matched, a correct
 transfer reproduces the direct serve's first-token log-probabilities exactly,
 so the comparison needs no noise allowance. The
-servers compile with Inductor's deterministic mode, since otherwise each one
-benchmarks its own reduction launch configs and separately started servers
-can drift apart by a few bf16 logit steps. Guards:
+servers compile with Inductor's deterministic mode and without pointwise
+autotuning, since otherwise each one benchmarks its own launch configs and
+separately started servers can drift apart by a few bf16 logit steps. Guards:
 
 * decode must report an external prefix-cache hit for every transferred token
   of every prompt, so the match is not a local recompute;
@@ -303,12 +303,17 @@ def id(self) -> str:
 def _graph_args(mode: str) -> list[str]:
     if mode == "NONE":
         return ["--enforce-eager"]
-    # Inductor otherwise picks reduction launch configs by timing them, so each
-    # separately compiled server may sum in a different order and drift by a
-    # few bf16 logit steps; deterministic mode fixes the choice.
+    # Inductor otherwise picks launch configs by timing them, so separately
+    # compiled servers may drift by a few bf16 logit steps: reductions sum in a
+    # different order, and on ROCm the pointwise block size changes which
+    # multiply-adds are fused into FMAs. Deterministic mode fixes only the
+    # reduction configs, so pointwise autotuning is off as well.
     config = {
         "cudagraph_mode": mode,
-        "inductor_compile_config": {"deterministic": True},
+        "inductor_compile_config": {
+            "deterministic": True,
+            "triton.autotune_pointwise": False,
+        },
     }
     return ["--compilation-config", json.dumps(config)]
